title: Rey Skywalker
franchise: Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker
description: Leia Organa trained Rey in the Force while the Resistance rebuilt itself after their stunning defeat on Crait. A broadcast made its way to them purporting to be the voice of the long-dead Emperor. Rey was forced to grapple with the reality of her ancestry, discovering that not only was Palpatine still alive, but that he was her grandfather and that she was connected to Ben Solo as a Force dyad. Together, she and Ben stood against Palpatine, with Ben giving his life so Rey could live hers. She adopted the name Skywalker to honor the family that took her in.
